Locators are printed page numbers ('N / 190'), which equal PDF page numbers. 7 state-of-the-art (SOTA) papers and 52 technology papers (TP), each with an 'impact on energy efficiency' (thermal MJ/t cli, electric kWh/t), 'CO2 reduction potential' (direct/indirect kg CO2/t), material input and a cost table (investment Mio. EUR and operational EUR/t, new installation vs retrofit, rows 2015/2030/2050). All figures relate to a reference plant (Annex I-II, p.167-168: 2 Mio. t/a clinker, 3,510 MJ/t cli, 70 kWh/t cli, 842 kg CO2/t cli, 130 EUR/t annual capacity). LOADED (main): reference plant and its 1 and 0.5 Mt/a capex cases; BAT kiln fuel ranges by cyclone stages (SOTA 1); GNR precalciner average; long wet kiln; every TP with numbers as an example with description, incremental capex in Mio. EUR (retrofit column unless only new is given; derived EUR/t-per-yr only where the paper states the 2 Mio. t/a basis), opex-total = the printed operational cost CHANGE vs base case (negative = saving; COST BASIS incremental), and absolute parameters where printed (HTC char energy, capture rates, temperatures, Celitement emissions, emissions-reduction-potential %). 2015 cost rows are loaded; 2030 rows for CCS (2015 'not available'); 2030/2050 values are in notes. CCS papers (oxyfuel, absorption, CaL): absolute electricity, fuel and emissions derived as reference-plant value plus the printed change, formula given. Energy and CO2 SAVINGS of measures are in _measures (not absolute). NOT LOADED: TP 21 (energy management), 27 (advanced grinding), 32 (UHPC, in other-values), 48, 50, 51, 52 (CCU without technology numbers), SOTA projections (other-values). No TRL is printed anywhere. TRAPS: (1) units mix t clinker and t cement within one table (e.g. TP 2 new EUR/t cli, retrofit EUR/t cem; TP 10 retrofit per t cem vs TP 9/11 per t cli) - units carry -cement/-clinker suffixes where they differ from the service unit; (2) TP 44 cost remark (p.146) is a copy-paste about a power-to-gas plant; (3) TP 11 cost table columns are misaligned in the PDF text; (4) the '200-300 million EUR per kiln' CCS cost cited by Habert et al. 2020 is not printed as such: TP 44 absorption gives 100-300 Mio. EUR (2030), oxyfuel 355-380 new / 105-130 retrofit (2030), CaL 180-200; (5) heating-value basis is never stated (GNR convention is NCV/LHV but not printed); (6) price year not stated - Annex I lists 'Prices 2014, 2013, 2010'.
